input.command:
cat > fizzy_soda_adventure.txt << 'EOF'
Fizzy\'s Wild Ride

In the chilly depths of the refrigerator, lived Fizzy, a shiny silver can of cola. Fizzy dreamed of the world beyond the fridge door—sunny picnics, fizzy fountains, and thrilling rollercoasters.

One hot summer day, the fridge door swung open. "Now\'s my chance!" Fizzy whispered. With a sneaky roll, he tumbled out onto the kitchen floor.

"Watch out!" yelped Chipsy, a bag of potato chips. Together, they dashed across the counter, dodging crumbs and utensils.

They hitched a ride in a picnic basket, bouncing along to the park. There, under the sun, Fizzy met Lemonella, a sparkling lemonade.

"Pop the top!" cheered the kids. But Fizzy was too excited—SHAKE SHAKE! When opened, he erupted in a glorious fountain, spraying laughter everywhere.

From that day, Fizzy knew: sometimes, the fizziest adventures start with a little shake-up!
EOF
